ideas.idea: Invalidate the cache on write and bound it by a TTL.
ideas.why: Readers see stale data forever after a missed invalidation.
ideas.prompt: A price changes but the page shows the old one for an hour. What two rules would have prevented it?
ideas.answer: Delete or update the cached entry in the write path, and give every entry a TTL so a missed invalidation heals.

ideas.idea: Guard a hot key's refill so one miss does not become a thousand database reads.
ideas.why: An expiring hot key sends every reader to the database at once.
ideas.prompt: A popular entry expires at noon. Why does the database fall over at noon, and what stops it?
ideas.answer: Every reader misses together and refills; a single-flight lock or early refresh lets one reader refill.

ideas.idea: A queue consumer that may see a message twice must make its effect idempotent.
ideas.prompt: Your queue redelivers a message after a consumer crash. What must the consumer do?
ideas.answer: Record the message id with the effect in one transaction and skip ids it has already applied.
